name: Raspberry Lemonade Refresher
desc: Muddled raspberries shaken with vodka, raspberry lemonade and lime, then double strained.

source.title: Raspberry Lemonade Cocktail: A Berry Boozy Buzz
source.evidence: Same muddled fresh raspberries with 2 oz vodka, raspberry lemonade and 1/2 oz lime, shaken 10 seconds and strained over ice with mint; that version also adds simple syrup.

steps: Muddle the raspberries with the lime juice in the bottom of a shaker until the berries break down.
Add the vodka, raspberry lemonade and a handful of ice.
Double strain (through the shaker strainer and a fine mesh strainer) into a glass filled with fresh ice to catch the seeds. Garnish with the lemon wheel and mint leaves.
tips: Cabin Cravings muddles the mint with the berries and adds 1/2 oz simple syrup if you want it sweeter.

references.title: Raspberry Lemonade Cocktail: A Berry Boozy Buzz
references.usedFor: method and shake time, mint and simple syrup variation
